answer: Idle reputation decays 5 percent per epoch, so an identity that stops working loses standing faster than a new one can inherit it, and a replayed submission claws back the last three payouts and marks the account in the atlas. No identity may audit its own recruit, so a farm cannot grade itself back up, and each extra sparrow account adds maintenance with no matching income. A canyon opens between the cost of holding fakes and the yield they return.
